scenarios.name: banding-blocker-lets-defender-divide-attackers-damage
scenarios.why: Oracle: if any creatures with banding you control are blocking a creature, you divide that creature's combat damage, not its controller. Wall of Shields (0/4, defender, banding) and Grizzly Bears (2/2) block Hill Giant (3/3). The defending player p1 divides the Giant's 3 damage and puts all of it on the Wall (which has 4 toughness and survives); the Bears take none and deal 2, so the Giant, with 2 damage, survives. A blocking Wall deals 0 and needs no division.

pick: 3 to Wall of Shields,0 to Grizzly Bears

scenarios.name: defender-cannot-attack
scenarios.why: Defender (Oracle: this creature can't attack): Wall of Shields is never offered as an attacker, so it cannot be put in a band either.
